timeline.event: checkout config v42 deployed with EU tax endpoint mapping switch
tax service request failed: region mismatch for eu-order
retry failed: tax endpoint us-east cannot serve eu tax quote
incident detected: EU checkout requests failing with tax calculation errors

root_cause: incorrect EU tax endpoint mapping in checkout config v42
why_it_happened: deployment of config v42 switched EU tax endpoint mapping incorrectly
misconfigured routing sent EU tax requests to US region endpoint
US endpoint cannot process EU tax requests, causing region mismatch errors
ruled_out_hypotheses: payment gateway outage (would affect both EU and US checkout traffic)
database pool exhaustion (presents as pool timeout saturation, not region mismatch)
immediate_mitigation: rollback checkout config to last known good version (v41)
